description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system, outlining a method for outputting log data and illustrating an extensible logging chain in an Android project.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain that can output logs and pass them along to the next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable for exception details.
